title: Card, normal kind
description: A file in data/card/. The ordinary kind: one face, its values held directly. Every part of the type line and the mana cost is held as the id of a value in a list under data/component/, in the order the paper prints it.

mana_cost.description: The mana symbols of the mana cost, in printed order. Each value is the id of a value in data/component/mana_symbol.json. Left out when the card has no mana cost.

colors.description: The colors of the card. Each value is the id of a value in data/component/color.json. Left out when the card is colorless.

special_types.description: The special types of the type line, in printed order. Each value is the id of a value in data/component/special_type.json. Left out when the type line has none.

card_types.description: The card types of the type line, in printed order. Each value is the id of a value in data/component/card_type.json.

subtypes.description: The subtypes of the type line, in printed order. Each value is the id of a value in data/component/subtype.json. Left out when the type line has none.

oracle_text.description: The rules text on the Oracle reference.

power.description: Power, when the card is a creature; e.g. 2.5 or *.

toughness.description: Toughness, when the card is a creature.

loyalty.description: Starting loyalty, when the card is a planeswalker.

defense.description: Defense, when the card is a battle.

component_id.description: The id of a value in a list under data/component/.

history.description: Records of official corrections. Appended only; past records are never rewritten.

face.description: The number of the face, counted from 0, when the corrected value sits inside a face.

was.description: What the value said immediately before this correction.

corrected_at.description: The date the value changed in this repository.
